outcome-unread.why: the run wrote no readable outcome file: it crashed or was cut off, which says nothing about the issue

outcome-invalid.why: the run's outcome file names no known exit, a fault in the run, not a finding about the issue

scan-refused-patch.why: the scan job refused the run's patch for its size, so a fresh run may make a smaller one

scan-refused-output.why: the scan job refused the run's output for a reason only its log names, which may be a credential shape, a security judgment

issue-file.why: the runner could not write the issue file, a runner fault before any model ran

issue-edited.why: the issue's title or body changed after agent-ready was added, and only a listed human's new agent-ready admits the edited text

patch-protected-path.why: the change needs a path the issue lane may not push, which a maintainer session builds by hand

host-only.why: the run reports the work needs a host or attended run the lane cannot make

patch-invalid.why: apply-issue-patch refused the patch, a reason that also covers a patch carrying a credential shape, a security judgment

patch-not-applied.why: the patch did not apply to the commit the run started from, so a fresh run starts from the current one

patch-apply-failed.why: apply-issue-patch failed before it committed or refused the patch, a job fault

done-no-commit.why: the run reported done but committed nothing

resumed-unchecked.why: the runner's checks did not pass over the resumed branch, so the next run continues it

check-failed.why: a check the runner ran on the branch failed or could not be read, so the next run continues the branch

required-undone.why: the run left a required check undone, so the next run continues the branch

pr-head-moved.why: the PR opened at a head other than the tip the runner checked, a race, not a finding about the issue

turn-cap-spent.why: the run reached its turn cap with no restart left

retry-spent.why: the lane has retried this issue as many times as limits.stop-retries allows

pushback.why: the issue leaves a decision open, an intent question only a person answers

intent-change.why: the run found the work changes the issue's intent, which a person decides

design-change.why: the run found the work changes the primary design, which a person decides

security-risk.why: the run reports a HIGH or CRITICAL security risk, which a person decides

cost-risk.why: the run reports a HIGH or CRITICAL cost risk, which a person decides

stopped.why: the run stopped for a reason it gave no code for, so the lane cannot tell it from an intent or design finding

split-required.why: the issue's Size is too large for one run, and splitting it decides its scope

research-first.why: the issue's Uncertainty says research comes first

probe-first.why: the issue's Uncertainty says only an experiment answers it
